title: Host step from a host configuration
statement: Let $S$ be a finite-state deterministic Boolean machine, let $A$ be a nondeterministic Boolean machine, and fix a Boolean loop parameter and Boolean input $x$. For any Boolean choice, clock phase, input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions for both machines and the clock tape, and output word, taking one host-machine step from the host configuration with that data gives the same configuration as applying the action prescribed by the host transition function at that phase, choice, scanned input symbol, and scanned work-tape symbols.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite-state deterministic Boolean machine
arbitrary work-tape contents and head positions for $S$ and $A$
arbitrary clock-tape contents and head position
